reason: I already get the weekly ideas from my YouTube gurus in Hindi, and I'm not going to hand my channel and my name to an app that pitches shops and coaching centres on my behalf. The price is not the problem, it's whether I can trust what it sends out in my name.
objection: Who is actually talking to the brands? If Mitra negotiates a rate for me and a shop owner thinks I agreed to something I didn't, that's my reputation, not the app's.
would_change_my_mind: A free week where I can see Mitra's plan for my own channel and approve or reject every single brand message before anything goes out, with the fee stated up front.
